title: Benchmark Nansen as an optional read-only Shadow intelligence adapter for Alpha Lab
objective: Implement the smallest deterministic read-only harness required to compare current Alpha Lab/free onchain evidence with official Nansen API/MCP output on the same frozen private benchmark cohort. Measure duplicate coverage, unique verified facts, entity-resolution improvement, point-in-time label leakage, research latency and credits consumed. Preserve Nansen-derived data as provider-attributed research evidence only. Do not enable paid backfill, recurring polling, public watchlist exposure, trading, signing, portfolio authority, signal promotion or a parallel market engine.

scope: inventory overlap between existing/free Alpha Lab fields and desired Nansen fields
define provider-attributed point-in-time response envelope with retrieved_at/effective_at/observable_at where available
add deterministic credit accounting and zero-paid default
add read-only fixtures and explicit no-credentials/no-call degradation
bind private benchmark manifest without exposing exact identifiers publicly
run FRAMEWORK_BASELINE, FREE_RAW_EQUIVALENT, NANSEN_AUGMENTED and optional NANSEN_ONLY arms on identical frozen tasks
measure unique verified facts, duplicate coverage, entity resolution, label conflicts, point-in-time leakage, latency and credits
preserve Nansen labels as EXTERNAL_LABEL_PRIOR rather than canonical truth
only if incremental value is demonstrated, implement optional NANSEN_SHADOW_ADAPTER behind existing research routing
no recurring provider calls unless expected information gain justifies cost and governance allows it

positive: The same frozen benchmark case and timestamp are used across all experiment arms.
Every Nansen-derived field records provider attribution, retrieval timestamp, endpoint/tool and credits consumed.
Historical labels that cannot be reconstructed point-in-time are marked RETROSPECTIVE_LABEL_RISK.
Exact competitive wallet/token identifiers remain in the restricted data plane and do not appear in public logs or artifacts.
The harness can complete the baseline/free arms with zero Nansen credentials and reports provider arm as unavailable rather than fabricating data.
Provider calls are read-only and default to zero-paid/free capability until separately authorized.
Ablation output distinguishes unique verified information from fields already available or derivable free.
No provider PnL or chart return substitutes for Alpha Lab executable-return outcomes.
negative: No current Nansen Smart Money label may be silently back-applied to an old decision timestamp.
No Nansen label may independently promote a wallet/token to QUALIFIED_ALPHA or a trade signal.
No authenticated UI scraping, proprietary-database copying or proprietary algorithm reverse engineering is permitted.
No paid backfill, recurring paid polling, budget increase, wallet signing, transaction preparation, BUY/SELL/size output or portfolio action is permitted.
No new parallel research engine or market-state owner may be created.

forbidden_changes: paid Nansen acquisition without separate authorization
